purpose: Name the Level-09 callback cadence that gates the coordinate-triggered Type-0x50 spawn.

owner.name: Level09_EnterRoutine
owner.increment: Increment the byte at 0x001B614C on each Level-09 callback.
owner.wrap: Clear it at 0x001B615C when it reaches 0x50.
owner.gated_action: After the wrap, evaluate the player-coordinate window and spawn ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_50_LEVEL09_SPAWN_BASE into a backward free slot.

separate_cadence: The later Type-0x52 spawn branch is gated by FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER and does not consume this byte.
evidence: Exact increment, wrap, coordinate gate, and Type-0x50 spawn instructions
conclusion: FFF118 is the Level-09 Type-0x50 spawn cadence counter.
